messages.content: Hello! I'd be glad to help you review that Dem Reuters Dermatology content for your exam. A typical moderate-to-severe psoriasis presentation features widespread, erythematous plaques with markedly silvery scales, often involving the scalp, elbows, knees, and lower back. Patients frequently report intense pruritus, occasional bleeding when scales are removed, and significant psychological stress due to visible skin changes.
